subject.title: feat(durable): hand off wakes to session queue

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107559 replace this PR as the canonical landing branch, and should durable wake `systemEvent` ownership follow the logical session key across session-generation resets?
rationale: The code can support the demonstrated logical-session behavior, but only maintainers can choose the permanent stack topology and whether a wake belongs to the original session generation or whichever generation currently owns the canonical key.

options.title: Adopt the refreshed PR
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107559 canonical, transfer the live proof, and explicitly test and document logical-session delivery across resets.

options.title: Keep generation-bound ownership
options.body: Require the wake queue entry to carry and enforce the originating session generation before either PR lands.

options.title: Pause the durable handoff
options.body: Keep inspection-only durable wakes until maintainers approve the broader durable-core and recovery policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt the refreshed PR
recommendation.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107559 canonical, transfer the live proof, and explicitly test and document logical-session delivery across resets.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work on restart handoff state and shared-state recovery makes this the strongest available routing signal for the ownership decision.
